acceptances.reason: No patched picomatch exists. The ReDoS needs an attacker-written extglob pattern, and no path here takes a pattern from untrusted input. The private `site` package reaches picomatch through build-time TanStack router tooling, which globs this repository's own route files. The published `@stablemates/workhorse-typeorm` reaches it through its `typeorm` peer, which globs only the `entities`, `migrations` and `subscribers` paths the application's own developer writes into its DataSource configuration. The adapter receives an already-built DataSource and passes typeorm no glob.
